items.question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: Earlier statements enumerate female figures who know through devotion on earth.
The owl-woman and peacock-woman are presented as included alternatives.
The sararī-woman and gūlī-woman are likewise added to that group.
items.inference: These named female figures also belong among the devoted knowers on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identities or symbolic roles of sararī and gūlī are unclear.
items.plain_english: Likewise included are the owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman.
